what: Woodside Energy is Australia's largest independent oil and gas producer. Most of its value is in liquefied natural gas, shipped from Western Australia to Asian buyers, and it is building the Scarborough and Louisiana LNG projects.
customers: Japanese, Korean, Chinese and other Asian utilities and gas buyers under long-term contracts, plus oil buyers.
money: North West Shelf, Pluto and Scarborough
Australian and Gulf of Mexico production
moat: LNG plants in Western Australia with decades of resource behind them, sited closer to Asian buyers than Gulf Coast or Qatari supply.
risks: Debt of about $14 billion while two very large projects are under construction
Australian environmental approvals have delayed projects before
Only one analyst covers it in this data
opportunities: Operating margin of 30% with a dividend yield near 6%
Scarborough and Louisiana LNG add substantial production this decade
Long-term contracts with Asian buyers provide revenue visibility
watch: Project construction against budget and schedule, and realised LNG prices.
